name: iMessage
description: Send, read, and manage messages through Apple's Messages app
long_description:
This extension allows Claude to interact with your macOS iMessage app, enabling sending, reading, and managing messages. Ask Claude to summarize your recent messages, help you understand what's most important.

It uses macOS automation features to interact with the Messages app and requires your explicit permission through macOS security prompts before accessing Messages or Contacts. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

tools.name: send_imessage
tools.description: Send an iMessage to a contact

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name, phone number, or email address

tools.name: read_imessages
tools.description: Read recent iMessages from a specific contact
